ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   C. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   C. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   B. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).

6. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   C. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   C. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   C. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.
   B. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)

   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Miracles of Prophets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
